findings.article_anchor: exact existing span, or empty for absence
findings.materiality: why this affects the requested understanding

patches.after: replacement; may preserve before and append a new sentence
patches.justification: why this exact change is warranted; distinguish evidence-backed correction from preservation

question_answers.answer: evidence-bounded response; distinguish original article and proposed change

unanswered_scope: unanswerable or unprocessed components; do not invent evidence
no_change_reason: if patches empty, explain why; otherwise empty
declared_limits: limits of supplied evidence and capture scope
